title: 5 Teens Get Busted After Crazy Police Chase
description:
On March 19th, 2022, officers responded to a civil dispute involving teenagers. Just before the victims called dispatch, a nearby officer heard two gunshots and immediately pursued a speeding Mazda. Soon, while pursuing the suspect's car, the officer traps them in a dead end, but they reverse and evade the officer, almost hitting him while doing so. The officer lost the tail, but four other officers spotted the car and initiated a pursuit. They were about to corner the suspects at their home. Meanwhile, another team of officers met with the victims to get more information about the incident. The other team of officers began removing the remaining passengers from the suspect vehicle, and most of them were intoxicated. The next passenger who was going to come out of the car was Drake, who had been accused of stealing the clothes of the victim's son and his friend. Meanwhile, another officer was attempting to take the statement of the victim's son, but he was being uncooperative. The officer had recognized the boy from a previous case and had crucial information to share with his family. The other team of officers was soon able to remove all the passengers from the vehicle. One of the officers interrogated Drake about the whole situation. One of the females sitting in the Mazda recorded a video while the argument between the suspects and the family was taking place. The officers found multiple guns and ammunition inside the silver Mazda. One of the passengers admitted to owning them. One of the females gave the officer an accurate description of the events while getting interrogated. There were 4 females and 2 males in the suspect vehicle. After interrogating all of them, only the passenger named Artist and the car's owner, Mikayla, were taken into custody. Meanwhile, one of the officers tried to reason with Jeremiah. The female was turned over to her parents with a citation, while the male was transported to the jail. The male was charged with negligence in carrying a deadly weapon, intoxication, and having an open container inside a motor vehicle, while the female was cited for resisting and evading an officer.

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
